cues: A linking verb, be, seem, look, feel, taste, sound, smell, become, is followed by an adjective: the soup tastes good; I feel bad.
An action verb takes an adverb: she sings nicely; he speaks English well.
Good is the adjective, well is the adverb.
So the food tastes well, she sings very nice and I am feeling very badly are all wrong.
